summary: Hệ điều khiển cục bộ agent-first cung khả năng khám phá catalog, lựa chọn tự động và kiểm tra stack cho hơn 2.600 skill agent, kèm CLI, local MCP và Workbench.
usecases: Manage and distribute agent skills across development teams.
Automate pipeline planning and stack validation before deployment.
Provide a Workbench for developers to test and combine agent skills intuitively.
ideas: Integrate with CI/CD to automatically validate skill compatibility on pull requests.
Build a dashboard monitoring agent skill performance and interaction metrics.
Create a distributed skill marketplace based on local MCP for the open-source community.
